title: Vell's personal quest consistently names her ledger's location as 'Hollowbrook' ('The Keepers' Hall in Hollowbrook') everywhere it's mentioned during play, but the game's final epilogue instead calls the same place 'Barrowmere' ('Vell's ledger stayed unread in Barrowmere,' 'the great mound's door still stands at Barrowmere's edge') — two different names for what should be one hold.
where: Quest 'The Exile's Ledger' vs. final status epilogue
